subject: LumenStore renewal — competitive bake-off & contingency plan
messages:
From: Tara Simmons <tara.simmons@lumenstore.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: LumenStore renewal — upcoming bake-off and RFP

Hi Kimberly,

Quick heads-up: our renewal with Redwood is up in six weeks and procurement has kicked off a formal bake-off. Two vendors (one of them a new managed provider) have already offered aggressive pricing, and the procurement team wants a short benchmark and total-cost comparison before making a recommendation.

Can Redwood put together a short benchmarking exercise (latency, throughput, token cost) and a proposed commercial contingency in case we go to the managed provider? Our priorities are predictable latency for peak search traffic, a 99th percentile SLO, and no loss in generation quality.

I attached our RFP summary and volume projections—happy to share a short call next week to align.

Thanks,
Tara Simmons
Head of Platform, LumenStore
Attachments: LumenStore_RFP_Q3.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tara Simmons <tara.simmons@lumenstore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenStore renewal — upcoming bake-off and RFP

Tara — thanks for the note and for sharing the RFP. We’re on this.

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
- Internal triage: Ben (AE) + Monica (CS) + I will review the RFP and match the benchmarks to your prioritized tests.
- Quick benchmark plan: 48-72 hour focused tests measuring 95/99p latency, throughput at peak QPS, and per-token cost across our model variants.
- Contingency commercial: outline a short-term capacity/price protection to bridge to renewal if needed (we’ll propose a 90-day burst credit + temporary unit-price adjustment tied to a 12-month commitment).

Can you share: token volumes (p50/p90/p99), peak QPS, and any latency targets in ms?

We’ll aim to have a draft benchmark plan and a concise executive save summary by Friday.

—Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 00:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenStore renewal — upcoming bake-off and RFP

Kim / Monica — I read the RFP. Quick thoughts:

- Benchmark plan: propose a 3-scenario test (baseline traffic, peak peak, and synthetic adversarial long-context). We'll test on the same seq lengths and payloads they use.
- Metrics to collect: 50/90/95/99 latencies, median tokens/sec, effective cost/token by model + quantization, and quality pass rate on a 120-prompt prompt set from LumenStore.
- Commercial play: I can propose a time-limited Renewal Guard: 12-month contract with a 10% promotional discount for months 1–3 + $75k burst credits to cover peak load during migration window. We should bake in a rollback SLA and an option to increase dedicated capacity if latency degrades.

I attached a simple benchmark-template.xlsx to ensure we capture the same fields as procurement expects.

If Marissa (manager) wants to approve a promo, I can get procurement-aligned pricing by EOD Thursday.

—Ben Carter
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: benchmark-template.xlsx
From: Tara Simmons <tara.simmons@lumenstore.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 08:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: LumenStore renewal — upcoming bake-off and RFP

Kim — thanks, that framework looks great.

Below are the quick volume targets:
- avg tokens/day: 45M (p50)
- p90 tokens/day: 120M
- peak QPS (search spikes): 220 QPS sustained over 10 minutes
- latency target: p99 < 600ms for short-form generation (<=128 tokens)

We have a competitor demo booked for next Tue and procurement wants Redwood’s executive summary + any proposed commercial protections before their internal recommendation. Would you be able to provide a one-page exec summary + a short mutual-action plan by Monday morning their time?

Thanks — I can also share some sample prompt sets for quality checks.

Tara
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: LumenStore save plan — proposed concession

Kim / Ben / Monica — I reviewed the ask and approve a constrained concession for this renewal to preserve account momentum:

- Offer: 12-month renewal commitment at list with a promotional adjustment: 10% off unit price for months 1–3 and $75k burst credits applied to Redwood Dedicated pool.
- Conditions: 12-month minimum term, no retroactive credits, and a documented rollback clause if performance drops below the agreed SLOs.
- Timeline: Deliver a one-page executive summary + M.A.P. (mutual action plan) and a short draft amendment by Monday so Kimberly can share with procurement before the competitor demo.

I attached a quick save-plan draft with language procurement typically accepts. Ben — please finalize the financials (units/pricing lines) and Monica, validate the ops play (dedicated pool sizing + canary plan).

—Marissa
Attachments: lumenstore-save-plan-draft.docx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tara Simmons <tara.simmons@lumenstore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 06:12:00 -0700
Subject: LumenStore — Exec summary & contingency amendment (for procurement)

Tara — thanks again for the volumes and the call schedule. Attached is a one-page executive summary and our proposed short amendment. High-level highlights:

- Performance: Redwood commits to a focused 72-hour benchmark with 95/99p latency reporting and a canary rollout window. If p99 > 600ms on agreed tests, we will provision an immediate capacity increase and cover the cost of the scaled pool for 30 days.
- Commercial contingency: 12-month renewal with 10% off months 1–3 + $75k burst credits applied to usage; credits expire at 90 days and are only available for traffic verified during the canary testing window.
- Next steps: 1) Review the exec summary (Drive link) 2) Sign the short amendment (DocuSign) 3) Schedule the exec call (30 min) with Redwood and LumenStore procurement before Tue demo.

Links: Executive summary (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bC_example) | Amendment (DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/room/ABC-456-sign) | HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/12345

Let us know an available slot for a 30-min executive alignment call — we can be flexible. If procurement gives the competitor a demo, we’ll be on standby to provide any clarifying test outputs.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
